title: 第15章 清点战利品第16章 你也有今天
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
陆沉兴冲冲地跑回陆家，脸上洋溢着幸福的微笑，结果迎面撞见陆升，瞬间气氛尴尬起来。
陆沉点点头，结结巴巴地说道：“今天的事，谢谢你！”
“哼！
没用的东西，继续做你的废物就好了。”
陆升冷冷地回道。
陆沉闻言，脸上逐渐严肃起来，认真地说道：“不管你信不信，我一定会重新振兴陆家的，你就瞧好吧！”
陆升闻言愣了片刻，随即说道：“随你吧！”
说完头也不回地离开了。
9527在一旁看热闹，咂咂嘴说道：“原来他是这种傲娇的性格啊？以前怎么没看出来。”
见陆升走远，陆沉再也按捺不住心中的激动：“废话少说，我们快回去清点战利品吧！”
说着就往自己的房间跑去。
回到房间，陆沉谨慎地从里面锁好门窗，然后小心翼翼地取出今天的战利品：一个木盒，一个花瓶，一块龙涎木，一颗黑炎晶，当然还有那本《昆仑神女大战天山童姥》。
陆沉咬着牙，不甘心地问道：“苟系统，这本书不会是什么隐藏秘籍吧？”
苟系统毫不犹豫地打击道：“你想什么呢？那店里就一颗黑炎晶值钱，其他的全都是这种东西。
你别看那女的对你嬉皮笑脸的，现在指不定气的咬牙切齿呢！”
陆沉闻言，不满地看向苟系统：“那你为什么要让我买这个箱子？”
苟系统居然一本正经地回答道：“因为我真的很想看这本书啊！”
“你！”
陆沉气的哑口无言。
9527翻了翻白眼道：“今天本统子帮你赚了这么多，花你一百灵石就心疼了？”

“算了，你留着看吧！”
说着，陆沉把那本书丢给苟系统，苟系统直接把它收进系统仓库，然后自己取出来就在他手上了。
“哇，这插画，真白！”
9527看着那书口水都要流出来了。
陆沉一脸嫌弃地喊道：“你晚点再看啦！
先过来！”
苟系统闻言只能恋恋不舍地合上书，一脸不悦地来到陆沉身边。
陆沉拿起第一个木盒问道：“这个木盒里的功法怎么弄出来？”
“直接用神识探查就好了！
不过你身体恢复之前先不要尝试，你现在太虚了。”
9527故意在那个“虚”
字上加重了音量。
陆沉摇摇头：“好吧！”
说着把木盒收进系统仓库里，又拿起那个花瓶继续问：“那这个花瓶里的丹方？”
“把花瓶砸了就出来了！”
苟系统有些不耐烦地回答。
陆沉闻言把花瓶摔在地上，花瓶顿时摔得稀碎，一块布片出现在碎片中，陆沉拿起来一看，上面果然是二阶赤血散的丹方。
“这赤血散有什么功效？”
“苟宿主，你怎么什么都不知道！”
苟系统嫌弃地看着陆沉，继续说道：“赤血散能短时间内提升人体气血活性，从而暂时性地提高实力，药效过后会陷入一段时间的虚弱期，不过优点也很明显，那就是造价便宜，能量产。”

“那这药方我要怎么办？”
“那我就不知道了，你可以交给你老爸，或者卖了换灵石也不错。”
“卖肯定是不能卖的，现在陆家衰落，这赤血散能提升陆家的实力，但陆家没有炼药师，这可怎么办？要是你能炼丹就好了！”
9527闻言忿忿不平地吐槽道：“哇！
content_en:
Lu Chen happily ran back to Lu's house, with a happy smile on his face. Then he bumped into Lu Sheng, and the atmosphere instantly became awkward.
Lu Chen nodded and stammered: "Thank you for what happened today!"
"Hmph!
Useless things, just keep being your trash. "
Lu Sheng replied coldly.
When Lu Chen heard this, his face gradually became serious, and he said seriously: "Whether you believe it or not, I will definitely revitalize the Lu family, just watch it!"
Lu Sheng was stunned for a moment when he heard this, and then said, "It's up to you!"
After saying that, he left without looking back.
9527 watched the excitement from the side and smacked his lips and said, "So he has such a arrogant character? Why didn't I see it before?"
Seeing Lu Sheng walking away, Lu Chen could no longer suppress the excitement in his heart: "Stop talking nonsense, let's go back and count the loot!"
With that said, he ran to his room.
Back in the room, Lu Chen carefully locked the doors and windows from inside, and then carefully took out today's trophies: a wooden box, a vase, a piece of ambergris, a black flame crystal, and of course the book "Kunlun Goddess vs. Tianshan Child Mother".
Lu Chen gritted his teeth and asked unwillingly: "System Gou, isn't this book some kind of hidden secret book?"
System Gou struck without hesitation: "What are you thinking? There is only one black flame crystal in the store that is valuable, and all the others are like this.
Don't look at that woman smiling playfully at you, but now she is gnashing her teeth in anger! "
When Lu Chen heard this, he looked at Gou System dissatisfied: "Then why do you want me to buy this box?"
System Gou actually replied seriously: "Because I really want to read this book!"
"You!"
Lu Chen was speechless.
9527 rolled his eyes and said: "Ben Tongzi helped you make so much today, why do you feel bad for spending a hundred spirit stones on you?"
"Forget it, just keep it and watch!"
With that said, Lu Chen threw the book to Gou System. Gou System put it directly into the system warehouse, then took it out and put it in his hand.
"Wow, this illustration is so white!"
9527 looked at the book and his mouth watered.
Lu Chen shouted with disgust: "You can watch it later!
Come here first! "
After hearing this, System Gou could only reluctantly close the book and came to Lu Chen's side with an unhappy look on his face.
Lu Chen picked up the first wooden box and asked, "How do you get the skills in this wooden box?"
"Just use your spiritual sense to detect it!
But don't try it until your body recovers, you are too weak now. "
9527 deliberately placed that "virtual"
The words are emphasized in volume.
Lu Chen shook his head: "Okay!"
After saying that, he put the wooden box into the system warehouse, then picked up the vase and continued to ask: "What about the elixir in this vase?"
"Smash the vase and come out!"
System Gou answered impatiently.
When Lu Chen heard this, he threw the vase to the ground. The vase suddenly broke into pieces. A piece of cloth appeared among the fragments. Lu Chen picked it up and saw that it was indeed the second-level red blood elixir.
"What effect does this red blood powder have?"
"Host Gou, why don't you know anything?"
Gou System looked at Lu Chen with disgust and continued: "Chixue Powder can increase the activity of human qi and blood in a short period of time, thereby temporarily improving strength. After the effect of the medicine wears off, it will fall into a period of weakness. However, the advantages are also obvious, that is, it is cheap and produces energy."
"Then what should I do with this prescription?"
"Then I don't know. You can give it to your dad, or you can sell it for spiritual stones."
"You definitely can't sell it. Now that the Lu family is in decline, this red blood powder can improve the strength of the Lu family, but the Lu family has no alchemist. What should we do? If only you could make elixirs!"
